newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to cut oil product prices for July.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to cut oil product prices for July.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Friday it will lower its wholesale prices for gasoline, gas oil and kerosene for July shipment by 0.3 yen per litre.
The cut is a result of the yen's appreciation against the dollar between May 11 and June 10, which outweighed a rise in prices of May-lifting crude oil, a company spokesman said.
This will be the fourth consecutive month Nippon Oil has cut wholesale prices in its monthly price adjustments.
For July, gasoline and gas oil will be priced at 89.3 yen and 67.6 yen per litre, respectively, both including tax, while the price of kerosene will be cut to 35.5 yen a litre.
Kerosene is not taxed at the wholesale stage.
Major Japanese oil companies review their wholesale product prices on a monthly basis, taking into account international crude prices as well as fluctuations in the currency market.
